tei:div.tei:p: dbus gtsang dpon chen dang*/ sa skya nang chen rim pa'i byon tshul bzhugs/

oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud dri ma med pa 'di dang*/ hor rgyal po yon mchod du 'brel nas gtsug lag gnyis ka'i sgo nas/ bod khams bskyang ba'i phyir/ zhar la byung ba dbus gtsang dpon chen gyi rim pa ni/ thog mar dpon chen la snga ba shākya bzang po de la/ chos rje sa paṇa dgung lo re gsum pa sa pho 'brug la/ hor rgyal po e chen go dan gyi gdan 'dren byung nas/ byang phyogs sprul pa sder phebs dus/ bla ma 'u yug pa dang*/ shar pa sher 'byung ma gtogs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad kyang phyag 'tshal du bcug sa skya dang gzhi ba'i rgan pa la bskos nas bzhag bla ma 'phags pa'i dus su/ se chen gyi lung gi zon glu gun min dben hu'i ming dang shel dam gnang nas/ dbus gtsang gi dpon chen bskos/ khang gsar chen mo btab/ me pho 'brug lo la/ bla ma 'phags pa gong nas phebs pa'i bsu ba la dpon chen pas kyang byon dpon slob rnams gye re lha khang du bzhugs pa'i nub mo/ bla ma'i zhal nas mi khong la nye gnas go chod byung bas/ lha khang 'di lta bu bzhengs thub 'dug te gsungs pa dpon chen pa sku rgyab na yod pas gsan nas/ bla ma dam pa mnyes na 'di tsam rgya mthongs su tshud pa'i lha khang zhig bzhengs pa lags zhus pas/ nan ltar legs gsungs/ de 'phral la thig tshad byas par yar khyer nas/ 'dam sog yan dbus gtsang gi khri stong*/ mi sde rnams la bka' shog bkram/ mi lag bskul nas/ de kha'i lo la lha khang chen mo'i 'gram bting*/ lcags ri nang ma lcog spai 'bur lcog chung dang bcas pa brtsigs pa'i dus su/ shing cha rnams drangs nas lha khang chen mo'i 'og thog ci rigs phub tshar ba'i mtshams dpon chen ngang la sa skyar sku gshegs so/ /'di sa skya pa la yus po che'i mi gsum gyi rgan pa blon po drin chen du 'dug pa/ khong gi dbon po bsod dbang 'das rting dus mchod kyang mi gnang pas/ dpon chen dbang brtson gyis lha sa gro khud phul byung*/

ba mo gzhung rnams la gzhis chung re yod pa rtsad nas/ dus mchod la btsugs yod pas/ dpon chen dang nang so su 'dzin gyis 'di bzhin gyi do dam byed dgos/ dpon chen shākya bzang po'i rjes la/ nang gnyer kun dga' bzang pos dpon chen tshang ma lo drug byas/ de'i bar la lha khang gi lcags ri lcags chung 'og thog thigs khang zhabs su phyug par byas/ gser 'phru chen mo btsugs/ chos rje sa paṇa gyi nang bstan byang chub chen po'i gser sku dang*/ lha khang gi khyams la ri mo thams cad bzhengs/ rin chen sgang bla brang dang*/ dbu rtse byang lha khang bla brang dang bcas pa 'debs pa'i do dam byas/ kun dga' bzang pos las kha btad nas/ bya rog tshang du lo drug bcu'i bar la/ dpon chen zhang btsun dang*/ phyug po sgang dkar ba byang rin gsum po/ bla mas zhal ltas rim gyis bskos/ kun dga' bzang po la bla ma ma mnyes nas/ se chen gyi lung gi saṃ gha ching sang gis mgo byas rtsa ba'i hor dmag 'bum phrag gcig btang*/ dmag lam stag tshang phu la zhugs/ khang dmar gyis sa mkhar la mtshon kha bslangs te steng bya rog tshang la skor rgyag byas/ lcags pho 'brug lo la dpon chen khrims la bsgral/ de nas yun ring ma song bar bla ma 'phags pa yang zhi bar gshegs pas gong du zhu ba la nye gnas gzhon nu dbang phyug btang*/ se chen gyi lung gis byang rin la dpon chen bskos/ son wi sa'i dngul dam gling drug ma dang*/ shel gyi dam la yang gnang*/ rting la byang rin shang sdong po thang gis sgar thog tu kun dga' bzang po'i g.yog byang pa ye shes bzang pos bsad zer/ de nas dpon chen kun gzhon/ dpon chen gzhon dbang*/ de'i ring la phye bsal chen po dang*/ khrims gyi zhib cha phal cher byung ba/ de nas don chen byang rdor/ de nas dpon chen ag len/ de'i ring la lha chen mo'i spen bad bkal/ rgya mthongs ka brgyad btsugs/ thigs khang logs la bla ma bdag nyid chen po'i bka' bzhin/

phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor mi gcig pa drug brgya sum cu rtsa dgu bzhengs/ shing mo lug lo la phyis lcags ri chen mo dang*/ dbon po ri'i lcags ri gtod pa/ bla ma 'phags pa dang*/ dharma pha la'i phyi bstan bzhugs sa'i gser thog g.yu thog 'gel ba/ jo mo gling 'debs pa/ 'bri gung la dmag 'khyer ba sogs/ gdan sa chen po'i 'a chags kla phyag bla phyi dang*/ zhabs tog byas pa shin tu che bar byed/ dgas por dmag 'khyer jus legs lon pa'i dus/ sa mtshams na brag la ag len gyi ming bris pa bzhag 'dug zer/ bzhon dbang dang*/ byang rdor/ ag len gsum gyi ring la/ sa 'bri 'thab/ ag len gyi dpon chen ngang la rgya yul du byon/ a yu par pa rdar/ bu yan du rgyal bu dang mjal/ mi rabs kyi bar la yar 'brog khri skor 'jags pa'i lung bzang po thob/ de nas yang dpon chen gzhan dbang la bskyar nas bskos/ che gsal la sogs pa 'di'i skabs su byung bar yang byed/ de nas dpon chen legs pa dpal/ dpon chen seng ge dpal/ dpon chen 'od zer seng ge 'di'i swan jing dben gyi dam kha yang bzung*/ de nas dpon chen kun rin/ dpon chen don yod dpal/ dpon chen yon btsun/ yang dpon chen 'od zer seng ges bskyar nas byas/ de nas dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po/ dpon chen dbang phyug dpal/ dpon chen bsod nams dpal/ dpon chen nam mkha' bstan pa'i tshab la/ yang dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po khyon gyis bskos bskyar nas byas/ de nas dpon chen dbang brtson/ de nas dpon chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ de nas dpon chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ dpon chen dpal 'bum/ dpon chen grags dbang*/ rting ma ming gi dpon chen la/ a mo gha pa rnams byung ngo*/ /sa skya nang chen gyi rim pa ni/ thog mar nang chen kun dga' bzang po/ de'i tsha bo dpon gzhon nu dpal/ dpon kun gzhon/ dpon don grub dpal/ dpon blo/ zha lu dpon shes/ ston pa rin chen dpal/

dpon grub bzang*/ nye gnas dkon mchog bzang po/ nye gnas 'jam rgyal/ yang ston pa rin chen dpal/ lung gis bskos/ ston pa ring mo/ jo btsun kun shes/ nye gnas kun dga' 'phel/ dpon yon btsun grags pa dar/ lung gi bskaus/ si tu'i dam kha byung*/ yang gsar bskos byas/ rin bsam du dban shā lung gis bskos/ nye gnas nam mkha' rgyal mtshan lung gis bskos/ dpon kun rin nye gnas 'bum skyabs/ nam mkha' dpal du dben sha nye gnas bzang po dpal/ dpon po chos rgyal/ dpon seng ge rgyal mtshan/ shes rab 'od zer du dben shā /dpon po dkon mchog rin chen/ nang pa 'phags pa dpal bzang po/ nang pa kun dga' 'bum/ nang chen kun dga' 'phags/ nang chen rab mthor 'phags rnams so/ /dpon chen nang chen rim pa'i byung tshul 'di/ /mi chen blo chen bya las 'dzin pa rnams/ /brtse chen khur chen 'khur cing chab srid kyi/ /sa chen bde chen thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba/dbus gtsang dpon chen dang*/ sa skya nang chen rim pa'i byon tshul/ -PAGE 194--PAGE 193--PAGE 191-
